name: Slingshot
strategy: Use one formation to create movement or attack opportunities for another formation.

commands.name: Anchor and Launch
commands.effect: Choose one friendly Unit that has not voluntarily Moved or Blinked this Round. A different unengaged friendly Unit within 2" may immediately Move up to 3", ending legally and unengaged.

commands.name: Exploit the Opening
commands.effect: If a different friendly Unit inflicted unsaved Damage on an enemy this Round, the active Unit gains Critical 1 on its next Melee Attack against that enemy this Round.

commands.name: Create the Gap
commands.effect: After a friendly Unit inflicts unsaved Damage with a ranged Attack, a different unengaged friendly Unit within Short of the enemy may immediately Move up to 2", ending unengaged.

commands.name: Launch Platform
commands.effect: If the active Unit is unengaged and within 2" of a friendly Asset, it immediately resolves Blink 2.

commands.name: Relay Maneuver
commands.effect: Choose one friendly Unit. A different unengaged friendly Unit within Short of it immediately resolves Blink 3.

doctrineIdentity: Sequential cooperation and transferring tactical opportunities between Units. Unlike Mobility, Slingshot typically requires two different friendly Units working together.
